title: Our Updated SOC 2 Type 2 Report Is Available
summary: LiteLLM's updated SOC 2 Type 2 report is now available through the LiteLLM Trust Center.
body_markdown:
Our updated SOC 2 Type 2 report is ready. You can access it through the[LiteLLM Trust Center](https://trust.litellm.ai/) .


This completes the recertification we[announced in March](https://docs.litellm.ai/blog/vanta-compliance-recertification) , run with Vanta and validated by an independent auditor.


If your security team needs the report for a vendor review, send them to[trust.litellm.ai](https://trust.litellm.ai/) . For any additional questions, emailsecurity@berri.ai .
